name: Test Skill LLM
description: Test LLM driving skill adoption during a chat. Fresh: calls skill_load for the 'alpha' skill. After the load result: calls the skill-provided covia_read operation through invoke_tool (proving same-transition append-only activation). After that result: reports SKILL_TOOL_RESULT. On later turns with the loaded skill body and tool-addition event present: reports SKILL_BODY_PRESENT plus tool-state status.
